_meta.eraBasis: The era of asOfA, the earlier cost observation. Cross-era pairs count once, in their starting era. This is not the production's opening era.
_meta.dateBasis: asOf describes the cost, reportedAt describes publication. Period averages use the documented period midpoint or end, explained in each source note. Neither dates nor amounts are extracted from URLs.
_meta.scope: Public amounts and source paraphrases only. No source quotations. These are research observations, never model inputs or permission to enable datedCosts. Coverage alone cannot establish no-worse recoupment categories or zero new false recoupments.
_meta.caveat: The long Phantom interval and the short Good Night budget-to-actual comparison are disclosed rather than treated as independent annual inflation measurements. Spider-Man pairs follow adjacent reported budget revisions, not every possible combination; production delays and redesign make these capitalization changes unlike annual running-cost inflation. Cabaret compares a preliminary budget with final reported capitalization. More dated observations are needed in every era. Dance of the Vampires also compares an early Broadway budget with mounted capitalization after a delayed opening. The Addams Family and Rocky compare early Broadway budgets with reported capitalization at opening; development changes are not isolated from inflation. These are not observations of the separate German Rocky production.
